input.question: I'm looking for a new workout that will help me build endurance and cardiovascular fitness. What would you recommend for me?
input.reader_query: I'm looking for a new workout that will help me build endurance and cardiovascular fitness. What would you recommend for me? (Please respond within 300 words.)

generated.raw:
For building endurance and cardiovascular fitness while staying land-based, I highly recommend **steady-state cardio** combined with **interval training** — both are proven to improve heart health, stamina, and overall endurance.

**Steady-State Cardio** (e.g., jogging, brisk walking, cycling, or rowing) is excellent for building aerobic capacity. Aim for 30–60 minutes, 4–5 times per week, at a moderate intensity (you can talk but not sing). This builds a strong foundation for endurance.

**Interval Training** (e.g., alternating 30–60 seconds of high-intensity effort with 60–90 seconds of rest or low-intensity recovery) is even more effective for boosting cardiovascular fitness and burning fat. Try 4–6 sessions per week — for example, 4 x 30 seconds sprinting or fast jogging, followed by 1 minute walking or slow jogging. You can also do “tabata” (20 seconds work, 10 seconds rest, repeated 8 times) for a high-intensity, time-efficient option.

**Add Strength & Mobility** to your routine: Include 2–3 strength sessions per week (bodyweight or light weights) to support endurance and prevent injury. Also, incorporate dynamic stretching or mobility work before and after workouts to improve joint range and reduce soreness.

**Other Land-Based Options**:
- **Cycling** (stationary or outdoor) — low
